title: Gudang language
extract: Gudang or Djagaraga is an Australian Aboriginal language. It is the traditional language of the Gudang people, and is the northernmost language of the Cape York Peninsula. It is closely related to Urradhi, its neighbour to the south, and distantly related to its neighbour to the north, the Western-Central Torres Strait Language, from which it borrowed quite a few vocabulary items.
